entries.title: Gasket Compression Seal
entries.summary: A macro view of a red rubber gasket being compressed between two aluminum plates, showing realistic deformation and the moment of airtight sealing.

runs.review_summary: Clean technical layout with strong typography, but the primary animation viewport is empty/white in the static shot.

entries.title: Glass Buoy Fresnel Focus
entries.summary: A rotating glass Fresnel lens buoy distorts the background water texture, focusing light into sharp, readable text as it aligns with the viewer.

runs.review_summary: A highly atmospheric and technically impressive composition that perfectly captures the 'quiet luxury' and optical physics brief.

entries.title: Glazed Porcelain Crackle
entries.summary: Macro animation of white porcelain cooling, revealing intricate crackle glaze patterns with a shifting subsurface light reflection.

entries.title: Halftone Moiré Scan
entries.summary: Overlapping CMYK halftone dot grids rotate slowly, creating hypnotic moiré interference patterns that resolve into a clear image or text.

runs.review_summary: Strong execution of the brief with excellent typographic hierarchy and accurate color blending, though the background pattern is static rather than showing the requested circular/rotational moiré interference.

entries.title: Halocline Density Layer
entries.summary: Abstract visualization of ocean haloclines where fresh and salt water mix, visualizing data flow through shifting density bands and refractive boundaries.

runs.review_summary: A strong, atmospheric visualization that captures the scientific brief with a distinct color palette and clear layer separation.

entries.title: Hammered Copper Pulse
entries.summary: A sheet of hammered copper reacts to invisible forces, rippling with liquid-metal physics and catching warm, industrial light.

runs.review_summary: Strong industrial aesthetic with excellent typography and atmospheric background, though the copper texture appears somewhat soft/blurry rather than sharp.

entries.title: Hammered Tin Hull
entries.summary: Close-up of soft tin sheet being hammered into a curved hull, showing progressive dents, stretching, and dull metallic sheen.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the 'cold working' concept with a realistic, dull silver material and a clear visual representation of the 'mosaic' facets.

entries.title: Hydraulic Relay Lockout
entries.summary: A macro animation of a red hydraulic safety latch engaging a silver relay, featuring heavy mechanical resistance, a sharp click sound, and a status light switching from amber to solid green.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the industrial aesthetic, perfectly matching the 'heavy and precise' constraint with a clean, high-fidelity UI.

entries.title: Ink Brush Lifting
entries.summary: The precise moment an ink brush lifts from paper, showing the ink's viscosity, the thread-like strand breaking, and the wet texture of the stroke.

runs.review_summary: A clean, minimalist composition that captures the mood well but lacks the requested photorealistic macro detail and material texture.

entries.title: Ink Well Precision Drip
entries.summary: A single drop of black ink forms on the tip of a glass dip pen. It hangs, trembling with surface tension, then falls slowly into a white ink well, creating a perfect, slow-radiating ripple that resolves into text.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the 'North Light' aesthetic and fluid dynamics concept, with a clean, high-fidelity UI that perfectly matches the brief's minimalist requirements.

entries.title: Ledger Line Justification
entries.summary: A typographic animation where loose ledger entries snap into perfect justification and alignment, simulating the quiet order of archival indexing under cool north light.

runs.review_summary: Strong archival aesthetic and typography, but the core 'justification' visual is broken by severe text overlap/clipping.

entries.title: Letterpress Emboss Deform
entries.summary: Simulating the physical compression of paper under a heavy letterpress block. Text presses into the substrate, creating dynamic shadows and highlights.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the letterpress effect with realistic shadow logic and a clean, tactile composition.

entries.title: Linen Press Tension
entries.summary: A macro animation of high-thread-count linen being pressed by a clean, white ceramic plate. The fabric compresses, creating soft shadows and revealing the weave.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the 'craft' aesthetic with a sophisticated, high-contrast typographic layout and a clean, well-rendered 3D plate.

entries.title: Magnetic Cursor Orbit
entries.summary: Nav labels gently orbit/attract toward the cursor with spring damping — tactile, premium, never gimmicky.

runs.review_summary: Clean, premium dark editorial layout with a clear nav and spring-constant documentation, but the background is flat and the core magnetic/orbit interaction is invisible in a static shot.

entries.title: Magnetic Ferrofluid Kerning
entries.summary: Black liquid metal letters deform and spike under simulated magnetic attraction, pulling towards a cursor with viscous, organic physics before snapping back into rigid typography.

runs.review_summary: Excellent static representation of the 'OFF' state, perfectly matching the dark, matte aesthetic and layout requirements.

entries.title: Magnetic Nav Rail
entries.summary: Cursor-bound navigation rail for Vector Harbor where items lean, scale, and magnetically dock under the pointer with elastic easing.

runs.review_summary: Clean, on-brief nav rail with correct palette and icons, but the brand name 'Vector Harbor' is absent and the page is mostly empty.

entries.title: Microfilm Reel Focus
entries.summary: A UI component that mimics the physical act of focusing a microfilm reader. Text shifts from heavy Gaussian blur to sharp clarity as the user scrolls or interacts, revealing archival records.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the 'Microfilm' aesthetic with accurate simulation of the optical blur state and a clean, mechanical UI layout.

entries.title: Molten Glass Pour
entries.summary: High-speed slow-motion visualization of molten glass pouring, emphasizing extreme viscosity, light refraction, and thermal glow.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the brief with a visually striking, realistic molten glass render and sophisticated typography.

entries.title: Neon Tube Ignition Logic
entries.summary: Words ignite one by one inside bent glass tubes, flickering with electrical hesitation before settling into a stable, warm neon glow along a dark circuit path.

runs.review_summary: Excellent atmospheric execution of the 'ignition' concept, capturing the pre-glow state perfectly with a strong circuit trace and dark aesthetic.

entries.title: Obsidian Loom Mask Reveal
entries.summary: Scroll-driven mask reveal for Obsidian Loom where woven headline strips unfold from dark ink bands into a high-contrast product story.

entries.title: Obsidian Sheer Slice
entries.summary: A block of obsidian fractures along conchoidal lines, revealing razor-sharp edges with high-contrast specular highlights and internal sheen.

runs.review_summary: Strong typographic composition and brand presence, but the visual focus is a generic lightning graphic rather than the requested macro obsidian fracture.

entries.title: Oxidized Brass Tarnish
entries.summary: A time-lapse animation of polished brass tarnishing, where dark verdigris blooms across the surface in organic, liquid-like patterns.

runs.review_summary: Excellent atmospheric execution of the brief with realistic verdigris textures, strong typography, and a cohesive material-aging aesthetic.

entries.title: Parallax Depth Layers
entries.summary: Three-plane scroll parallax with depth fog — landscape storytelling that stays smooth and reduced-motion safe.

runs.review_summary: Excellent atmospheric execution with clear depth layering and strong typography, though the foreground silhouette could be more distinct.

entries.title: Photo Grain Developing Scan
entries.summary: A high-contrast black and white editorial image 'develops' from negative to positive through a moving scanline, accompanied by intense, animated film grain that settles as the image sharpens.

runs.review_summary: Strong atmospheric darkroom aesthetic with good typography, but the hero image is a broken placeholder and the layout feels slightly disjointed.

entries.title: Porcelain Clasp Click
entries.summary: Two pristine white porcelain lugs rotate and engage with a satisfying, audible 'click', demonstrating the quiet precision of soft-machine mechanics.

runs.review_summary: Excellent adherence to the 'soft-machine' aesthetic with a clean, high-fidelity composition and expressive typography.

entries.title: Pressure Gauge Redline Fluctuation
entries.summary: A brass analog pressure gauge needle trembles and snaps against the redline zone, visualizing system stress and safety protocols with mechanical precision.

entries.title: Pressure Relief Valve Vent
entries.summary: A brass industrial pressure relief valve hisses, releasing a jet of white steam into a dark, cold atmosphere, with a gauge needle dropping to safe levels.

runs.review_summary: Strong atmospheric composition and industrial aesthetic, but the primary visual requirement (the steam jet) is completely missing from the static frame.

entries.title: Rail Switch Lock Mechanism
entries.summary: A close-up of a heavy iron rail switch lock engaging, showcasing the brutal precision of railway infrastructure with metallic sheen and tactile feedback.

runs.review_summary: Strong industrial aesthetic with excellent typography and a clear, functional visualization of the mechanism.

entries.title: Riso Registration Shift
entries.summary: A continuous loop of two-color screen print shifting in and out of perfect registration, mimicking the tactile imperfection of Riso duplication.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the Riso misregistration concept, perfectly capturing the mechanical aesthetic, color blending, and layout requirements.

entries.title: Saffron Watercolor Bloom
entries.summary: A macro animation of saffron threads dissolving in clear water, creating intricate red and gold pigment blooms against a sterile white backdrop.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the 'high-key studio' aesthetic with a sophisticated, editorial layout that perfectly balances typography and the fluid simulation.

entries.title: Salt Pan Crystallization
entries.summary: A macro view of salt crystals rapidly forming from evaporating brine in a desert pan, creating sharp geometric spikes and white ridges.

runs.review_summary: Captures the arid, desaturated mood and uses expressive typography, but fails to render the requested geometric crystal structures, appearing instead as a blurry, abstract composition.

entries.title: Screen Print Ink Bleed
entries.summary: Heavy serif type printed in thick black ink on rough cotton paper, where the ink slowly bleeds into the fibers, softening the sharp edges of the letters with a tactile, organic diffusion.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the screen-print aesthetic, perfectly capturing the misregistration, paper texture, and monumental typography brief.

entries.title: Shutter Scanline Decode
entries.summary: Text decodes from static noise into sharp clarity via a rolling green scanline, mimicking the refresh rate of an old CRT monitor resolving a signal.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the CRT scanline concept with perfect atmospheric lighting, noise texture, and typographic hierarchy.

entries.title: Staggered Mask Reveal
entries.summary: Editorial headline reveal via line masks and stagger — cinematic entrance without cheap fade templates.

runs.review_summary: Strong editorial composition with a characterful display face, warm dark grade, and clean hierarchy that fits the darkroom/print-shop mood.

entries.title: Stainless Brushed Light Sweep
entries.summary: A macro shot of a brushed stainless steel surface where a moving light source reveals the micro-texture and anisotropic reflections of the metal.

runs.review_summary: The layout is clean and industrial, but the hero visual is too dark to demonstrate the requested brushed metal texture or light sweep effect.

entries.title: Substation Warning Flag Drop
entries.summary: A bright orange safety warning flag attached to a utility pole flutters violently in simulated wind, its fabric ripples catching harsh industrial light.

runs.review_summary: Strong atmospheric composition with excellent adherence to the 'utility' and 'safety' brief, featuring a well-rendered flag and pole.

entries.title: Sun-Bleached Rope Tension
entries.summary: A close-up of weathered, sun-bleached hemp rope under static load, highlighting individual frayed fibers and the stress of tension in harsh light.

runs.review_summary: A clean, minimalist composition that captures the 'arid' mood but fails to deliver the requested 'hyper-realistic' texture and lighting.

entries.title: Sun-Cracked Mud Heal
entries.summary: A reverse-animation of sun-baked mud cracking, where the fissures knit themselves back together, smoothing out into wet, pliable earth.

runs.review_summary: Atmospheric and on-brand, but the background texture is too blurry and abstract, failing to clearly depict the 'high-fidelity cracked mud' specified in the brief.

entries.title: Vellum Fold Mechanism
entries.summary: A macro animation of archival vellum folding along pre-scored lines. The paper compresses slightly under the fold, casting soft, precise shadows under cool north light, revealing a hidden layer of text.

runs.review_summary: Strong archival aesthetic with excellent typography and atmospheric lighting, though the hero visual is partially cut off in the viewport.

entries.title: Woven Reed Flex
entries.summary: A macro animation of woven reed strips bending under tension, showcasing the elasticity and interlocking tension of natural materials.

runs.review_summary: Strong typography and atmospheric background, but the 3D scene fails to render the actual 'woven' structure, appearing as disconnected floating pills.

entries.title: Abyssal Pressure Depth Scale
entries.summary: A vertical data visualization simulating ocean depth, where UI elements compress and distort under simulated hydrostatic pressure, revealing submersible specs.

runs.review_summary: Strong atmospheric hero with excellent typography and data overlay, though the glass material effect is subtle.

entries.title: Anodized Titanium Blotter
entries.summary: A color selection interface where users 'anodize' a titanium plate by adjusting voltage, shifting its iridescent oxide layer from straw to blue to purple.

runs.review_summary: A clean, well-typed layout that captures the laboratory aesthetic, but the central titanium plate is rendered as a flat grey blob rather than a textured, iridescent metal surface.

entries.title: Batik Wax Resist Flow
entries.summary: A generative textile pattern generator simulating the Batik process: hot wax applied to fabric resists dye, creating intricate, organic floral motifs.

runs.review_summary: A highly functional and aesthetically pleasing implementation that perfectly captures the 'Batik' theme with a warm, earthy palette and authentic texture.

entries.title: Beeswax Coating Layer
entries.summary: A visual layering system where semi-translucent beeswax coats a dark substrate, revealing warm amber tones and grain as the coating thickens or melts.

runs.review_summary: A solid execution of the material concept with good typography and texture, though the wax effect is subtle and the layout is inset rather than full-bleed.

entries.title: Bioluminescent Spore Dispersion
entries.summary: A generative visual where bioluminescent spores drift upward in a dark void, reacting to mouse proximity with gentle repulsion and light scattering.

runs.review_summary: A faithful, atmospheric execution of the brief with excellent color palette and particle variance, though the background lacks the requested 'foliage shadow' depth.

entries.title: Carbon Fiber Weave Configurator
entries.summary: A product configurator where users change the layup of carbon fiber, with real-time texture shifts and directional light reflections indicating fiber orientation.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the brief with a strong central visual, accurate lighting simulation, and a clean, technical UI.

entries.title: Cargo Manifest Ink Stamp
entries.summary: A digital document interface where 'approval' is a physical rubber stamp action. Users drag, rotate, and press a stamp onto textured manifest paper, leaving imperfect ink bleeds.

runs.review_summary: Strong adherence to the 'industrial document' aesthetic with excellent typography and texture simulation.

entries.title: Cast Iron Seasoning Layer
entries.summary: An interactive visualization of cast iron pan seasoning buildup, showing how heat and oil create a microscopic polymer layer over time.

runs.review_summary: Captures the correct industrial mood and typography style but fails to render the requested macro cross-section visual, resulting in a mostly empty dark screen.

entries.title: Desert Varnish Patina Map
entries.summary: A data visualization where information is revealed by simulating the slow accumulation of desert varnish on rock surfaces, using time-based oxidation effects.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the 'Desert Varnish' concept, using typography weight and color to simulate the staining process effectively.

entries.title: Dune Strata Geology Map
entries.summary: An interactive topographical visualization of desert strata, featuring long, sharp shadows and heat-haze distortion on a bone-white background.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the 'data-as-art' brief, perfectly capturing the minimalist, arid, and technical aesthetic with high-fidelity typography and layout.

entries.title: Editorial Brutalist System
entries.summary: Art-direction system: modular editorial brutalism — concrete grid, ink type, rules as structure, not decoration.

runs.review_summary: Strong, confident brutalist-editorial hero with a monumental BLOCK wordmark and disciplined type, though the background is nearly flat.

entries.title: Emulsion Breakpoint Visualizer
entries.summary: A generative visualization of sauce emulsion stability. Users adjust fat/oil ratios and agitation speed to see if the mixture holds or breaks.

runs.review_summary: Strong atmospheric design with excellent typography and color palette that perfectly matches the culinary brief.

entries.title: Ferrofluid Magnetic Response
entries.summary: A viscous black ferrofluid pool that reacts to cursor movement, forming sharp spikes and flowing pools based on simulated magnetic field strength.

runs.review_summary: A solid, atmospheric implementation that captures the 'calm pool' state well, though it lacks the dramatic specular highlights and sharp spikes described in the brief.

entries.title: Gasket Compression Diagram
entries.summary: A cross-section visualization of a rubber gasket being compressed between two flanges, showing material deformation and seal integrity in a calm, slow motion.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the 'soft realistic' brief with a clean, technical layout and accurate material representation.

entries.title: Glass Blown Syllable Expansion
entries.summary: Typography behaves like molten glass, expanding and cooling under simulated heat. Hovering a word heats it, causing it to swell and refract light before settling.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the 'Base State' requirement, featuring a clean void background and sharp typography that perfectly sets the stage for the interactive concept.

entries.title: Halftone Dot Mechanism
entries.summary: Interactive print simulation where images are formed by mechanical CMYK dot clusters. Hovering over text causes the halftone screen to rotate and scale, revealing the underlying photographic detail through dot gain.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the brief with a strong editorial layout, accurate halftone rendering, and precise spot-color details.

entries.title: Hazard Tape Peel Reveal
entries.summary: A UI layer covered in diagonal hazard tape that peels away to reveal safe, clean content underneath, emphasizing physical adhesive resistance and tearing physics.

runs.review_summary: Strong visual execution of the hazard tape concept with correct colors and typography, but the peel effect is static in the screenshot and the layout feels repetitive.

entries.title: Heat Haze Text Warp
entries.summary: Typography that vibrates and distorts via simulated heat haze, using SVG filters and displacement maps to mimic air refraction in a hot desert.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the brief with perfect color palette, bold typography, and clear UI indicators for the interactive distortion effect.

entries.title: Kiln-Fired Glaze Sample
entries.summary: A color selection interface where hues are represented by physical ceramic glaze chips, with heat-warp transitions and kiln-lighting ambiance.

runs.review_summary: A highly atmospheric and tactile interface that perfectly captures the 'potter's shelf' metaphor through excellent lighting and 3D rendering.

entries.title: Kintsugi Gold Seam Heal
entries.summary: An interactive visualization of broken ceramic shards rejoined with lacquer and gold dust, illustrating resilience through visible, beautiful repair.

runs.review_summary: The composition is atmospheric and clean, but the central subject fails to read as a 'ceramic bowl' and looks like abstract paper scraps.

entries.title: Linen Fold Typography
entries.summary: Typography that behaves like folded linen. Text is printed on fabric that creases, folds, and drapes, creating soft shadows and depth.

runs.review_summary: A clean, atmospheric composition that captures the mood but fails to render the core 'folded fabric' metaphor, looking more like standard serif typography with a drop shadow.

entries.title: Magnetic Morph Wordmark
entries.summary: A brand wordmark where letters act like magnetic poles. On hover, adjacent letters are pulled toward the cursor, distorting the geometry before snapping back into perfect alignment.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the brief with a bold, high-contrast wordmark and clean technical UI elements.

entries.title: Mirage Optical Illusion Kit
entries.summary: A UI component library where elements appear to dissolve or warp due to simulated heat haze and optical refraction on a sun-bleached canvas.

runs.review_summary: Captures the minimalist aesthetic and typography well, but fails to show the actual UI components (Input, Button, Toggle) requested in the brief.

entries.title: Moroccan Tadelakt Polish
entries.summary: An interactive material study of Tadelakt, Moroccan lime plaster. Users 'polish' rough stone with a river stone to reveal a smooth, water-resistant, glossy surface.

entries.title: Neon Tube Flicker Wiring
entries.summary: Typography as vintage neon tubes. Letters are outlined strokes that fill with light. Imperfect flickering, buzzing, and wiring delays create a nostalgic, electric atmosphere.

runs.review_summary: Captures the 'unlit' base state and wiring concept well, but fails to demonstrate the primary 'ignition' and 'glow' visual rules in the static capture.

entries.title: Night Blooming Time-Lapse
entries.summary: A seamless loop animation of a night-blooming flower (like a Moonflower) unfurling under a moonlit sky, with soft focus and slow, deliberate motion.

runs.review_summary: Captures the correct mood and color palette, but the flower subject looks like a generic 3D spiral or cookie rather than a realistic botanical bloom.

entries.title: Nocturnal Garden Moodboard
entries.summary: Night-garden brand moodboard for Lumenflora: bioluminescent botanicals, velvet dark, restrained type specimens.

runs.review_summary: Strong atmospheric moodboard hero with expressive serif type and bioluminescent glow that perfectly captures the 'nocturnal botanicals' brief.

entries.title: Offset Plate Registration Error
entries.summary: A kinetic type system where text layers (C, M, Y, K) slide into perfect alignment on scroll, simulating the high-tension registration of a press.

runs.review_summary: Strong execution of the CMYK misregistration concept with authentic subtractive color blending and a clean, technical layout.

entries.title: Oxidized Coin Valuation
entries.summary: A data card where the 'value' is revealed by cleaning a tarnished coin. Scrubbing the patina reveals the underlying metal and a numerical value.

runs.review_summary: Excellent atmospheric execution of the 'oxidized' concept with a strong, moody aesthetic and clear data integration.

entries.title: Photocopy Contrast Degradation
entries.summary: A high-contrast black-and-white interface where elements degrade into noisy, high-contrast photocopy artifacts the longer they are viewed or scrolled past.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the 'zine' aesthetic with strong typography and a clean, high-contrast layout that perfectly fits the brief.

entries.title: Piano Key Strike Cascade
entries.summary: Typography mimics piano keys. Letters are rectangular blocks that 'strike' down like hammers when triggered, creating a rhythmic, percussive text reveal.

runs.review_summary: Strong typographic composition and color usage, but the static screenshot fails to visualize the core 'mechanical key' concept (3D depth, perspective, or rectangular key shapes).

entries.title: Porcelain Insulator Hysteresis
entries.summary: A visualization of electrical hysteresis in porcelain insulators, where the loop is drawn as a smooth, white ceramic curve against a dark, quiet background.

runs.review_summary: A clean, minimalist composition that captures the 'calm' and 'industrial' vibe, but fails to visualize the core concept (the hysteresis loop) and suffers from poor framing.

entries.title: Pressure Gauge Needle Sync
entries.summary: A multi-gauge dashboard where mechanical needles vibrate and sync based on simulated pressure loads. Steam bursts occur at critical thresholds, shaking the UI.

runs.review_summary: Strong industrial aesthetic with accurate gauge rendering and atmospheric background, though the layout is split between text and gauges.

entries.title: Resonant Vowel Visualizer
entries.summary: Typography that reacts to vocal frequency. Letters expand, contract, and distort based on real-time audio input, visualizing the physics of sound through kinetic type.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the 'membrane' concept, perfectly visualizing the kinetic typography rules with a strong atmospheric background and clear data visualization.

entries.title: Saline Crystal Growth Timer
entries.summary: A countdown UI where time is measured by the geometric growth of salt crystals in a solution. As the timer runs, intricate 3D crystal structures form.

runs.review_summary: Clean, on-brand layout with strong typography, but the hero visual is a flat gradient blob rather than the required sharp, faceted crystal growth.

entries.title: Salt Flat Horizon Alignment
entries.summary: An interface where text and UI elements align to a distant, flat salt horizon, using extreme perspective and shadow length to convey scale and stillness.

runs.review_summary: The screenshot shows a blank page with a faint horizon line, failing to include the required typography or atmospheric elements.

entries.title: Slaked Lime Cure Timer
entries.summary: A status indicator that visualizes the slow carbonation of slaked lime, where a rough grey patch transforms into smooth white stone over time.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the 'material transformation' metaphor with a strong brutalist aesthetic and appropriate typography.

entries.title: Soft Industrial Toolkit
entries.summary: Design toolkit blending soft UI radii with industrial material cues — aluminum, porcelain, quiet warning stripes.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the 'soft industrial' brief with a strong, machine-true typographic hero and a clean, token-focused layout.

entries.title: Solar Flare Corona Visualization
entries.summary: Interactive solar corona visualization where magnetic field lines warp and plasma flares erupt, controlled by user-adjustable magnetic pressure.

runs.review_summary: Excellent adherence to the 'deep void' aesthetic with a scientifically accurate and visually striking plasma loop simulation.

entries.title: Stamped Manifest Alignment
entries.summary: A digital document verification interface where users must manually align and 'stamp' approval marks. The stamp leaves an imperfect, ink-bleeding impression on textured paper.

runs.review_summary: Strong execution of the 'bureaucratic' aesthetic with excellent typography and a clear, functional layout that perfectly matches the brief.

entries.title: Substation Relay Status Board
entries.summary: A utility dashboard mimicking physical relay panels. Status changes trigger mechanical relay clicks, LED matrix updates, and hazard stripe shifts.

runs.review_summary: Strong adherence to the industrial utility aesthetic with excellent typography and layout, though the LED matrix visual is currently empty.

entries.title: Sun-Bleached Textile Swatches
entries.summary: A digital fabric swatch selector featuring high-res textures of desert-worn textiles, with long shadows and natural light simulation.

runs.review_summary: Excellent adherence to the 'sun-bleached' aesthetic with a sophisticated, editorial layout and perfect typography choices.

entries.title: Sushi Neta Freshness Grid
entries.summary: A data visualization dashboard for sushi chefs, tracking fish freshness via temperature, time, and texture degradation in a sterile blue-white interface.

runs.review_summary: Captures the Swiss/minimalist aesthetic and color palette well, but fails to show the core 'Grid of Neta tiles' in the first viewport, prioritizing a generic hero section instead.

entries.title: Tidal Glass Horizon
entries.summary: A serene, abstract interface where a horizon line shifts like a tide, refracting text and imagery through a simulated curved glass lens. Quiet luxury aesthetic.

runs.review_summary: A faithful implementation of the 'Tidal Glass' concept, successfully executing the chromatic aberration and saline palette, though the typography leans towards monospace rather than the requested elegant serif.

entries.title: Tunnel Ventilation Baffle
entries.summary: An interactive visualization of a tunnel ventilation system. Airflow vectors push against metal baffles, which rotate to regulate flow. Tension between air pressure and mechanical resistance.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the brief with a strong industrial aesthetic, perfect adherence to color constraints, and a clear, functional interface.

entries.title: Typographic Tidal Lock
entries.summary: Celestial mechanics meets typography. Text orbits a central point, with speed and scale dictated by simulated gravity wells. A study in circular motion and hierarchical focus.

runs.review_summary: A strong, atmospheric execution of the brief that successfully renders 3D orbital typography with depth and perspective.

entries.title: Volcanic Ash Layer Accumulator
entries.summary: A slow-motion visualization of volcanic ash falling and settling in distinct strata, creating a textured, gray-scale topography over time.

entries.title: Wet Leaf Surface Tension
entries.summary: Macro-view of dark, glossy leaves where water droplets form, merge, and roll off, revealing sharp reflections of moonlight and distorted background colors.

runs.review_summary: Excellent adherence to the 'nocturnal macro' brief with realistic physics, atmospheric lighting, and sophisticated typography.

entries.title: Wood Type Incremental Heat
entries.summary: Heavy wooden letterpress blocks warp and expand under simulated cursor heat, revealing the grain and texture of the material beneath the ink.

runs.review_summary: Strong execution of the 'wood block' metaphor with excellent depth simulation and a cohesive, tactile aesthetic.

entries.title: Woven Wire Loom Grid
entries.summary: A navigation grid where links are represented by taut steel wires that vibrate and weave over/under each other when hovered, mimicking a loom's tension.

entries.title: Bioluminescent Firefly Pulse
entries.summary: A rhythm game where players sync clicks with an emergent swarm pulse. Join the bioluminescent rhythm, avoid desyncs, and master the chaotic beat in a single-file HTML experience.

runs.review_summary: Visually accurate to the brief's atmospheric requirements but missing all UI/HUD elements and the start overlay.

entries.title: Circuit Breaker Arc Timing
entries.summary: High-stakes timing game: close breakers when the oscillating electric arc is shortest. Industrial aesthetic, 5 circuits, precision scoring.

runs.review_summary: Strong industrial title screen with excellent typography hierarchy, atmospheric glow, and a well-structured HUD that fits the gritty electrician theme.

entries.title: Ferromagnetic Flux
entries.summary: Guide a steel ball to a goal by placing magnets that visualize real-time magnetic field lines. Drag to place, rotate to steer. Fail if the ball hits red hazards or exits bounds.

runs.review_summary: Strong adherence to the 'dark technical' brief with excellent HUD design and clear game state, though the initial view lacks the dynamic field lines described.

entries.title: Syncthron Drive
entries.summary: Engage a sliding gear exactly when teeth align with rotating drivers. Misalignment grinds the shaft. Reach 5000 RPM to win.

runs.review_summary: The game is functional and visually distinct, but the screenshot is blurry and the brand name is missing from the first viewport.

entries.title: Gimbal Lock
entries.summary: Rotate gimbals to align a laser with a moving target; fight precession and RPM decay to keep the beam steady.

runs.review_summary: Strong visual identity and typography, but the layout is cluttered with overlapping UI elements and the gyroscope visual is missing.

entries.title: Pulse Fix
entries.summary: Defibrillate the arrhythmia. Click precisely on the QRS spike to stabilize the ECG line. Miss the beat, and the patient flatlines.

runs.review_summary: Strong medical-terminal aesthetic with correct palette, Courier/Futura typography, and HUD, but the landing is a centered inset card rather than a full-bleed ECG hero.

entries.title: Harmonic Chorus
entries.summary: Adjust pendulum length to match resonant frequency of glass targets. Release to swing; correct timing shatters glass. Fail on mismatch or timeout.

runs.review_summary: Excellent execution of the physics toy concept with a cohesive dark aesthetic, expressive typography, and clear HUD integration.

entries.title: Satellite Orbit Sync
entries.summary: A rhythm-timing game where players drop data packets from orbiting satellites into a pulsing receiver window. Requires precise anticipation of orbital position and window phase to transfer 100GB of data before 5…

runs.review_summary: The screenshot displays a static landing page with instructions, directly violating the explicit constraint to exclude landing page elements.

entries.title: Seismograph Pulse Filter
